title: pm-dispatch: align execution-duties, SKILL.md and the seat-post and seat-lifecycle hot-file queues with #33941's merge-tree rule (one answer for same-file work)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: an out-of-scope finding from the L2 contract-review record on PR #34512 (#33941, record 6933258205), passed on by area `o2-S`. Dedupe: `same-file serial default`, `hot-file serial queue wording`. No open sibling card was found among the hot-file cards (#33942–#33949).

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#33941 把「同一个热文件只许一个写者」换成认领时和推送前各做一次 merge-tree 检查，规则写进了 `area-lease.md`。但 pm-dispatch 还有几处仍写着「同文件串行是默认」:`references/execution-duties.md` 第 32–35 行、`SKILL.md` 第 127 行附近，以及 `seat-post-protocol.md` 和 `seat-lifecycle.md` 里的热文件串行队。同一个问题现在有两套答案。
- 为什么要修：席位读到哪一处，就按哪一处做;两套答案会让同一种情形在不同席位得到不同处理。
- 需要你做的：无(Tier H 文本 PR 落地时照常审批)。

## Change

After PR #34512 merges, align the listed passages to the rule it lands. Each passage points to that rule's single home in `area-lease.md` and does not restate it. Pay for the lines under the line ratchet.

## Done when

`git grep -n` over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` for the old default ("same file → serial" and its Chinese wording) leaves only the pointer lines, and the PR body lists each hit before and after.

Blocked-by: #33941
